title: Math Card Extensions
description: Five independent studies extend the math-card theme into manipulatives, classroom stations, home kits, assessment tools, and playful tabletop scenes.
creative_direction: Independent studies test adjacent educational surfaces for the same math-learning line, keeping visual clarity and tactile logic while moving beyond the core card board.
